开局

压力
13 秒逐步缩短至 6 秒；每消 3 行移除一层基岩。
落石
20 秒开始，每次缩短 1 秒至 10 秒；每次随机 1–2 块可消落石，在同一随机列以普通方块 4 倍速度坠落。
结束

RULES
Start
Begin above 3 rising bedrock rows.
Pressure
The timer drops from 13 to 6 seconds; every 3 lines removes one bedrock row.
Stonefall
Starts at 20 seconds, then shortens by 1 to 10; each event drops 1–2 clearable rocks at 4× normal speed in one random column.
End
Bedrock pushes the stack to the top.
